scopes.lead_decision: REVERSED (cut-claude-lineage lane, 2026-09-22): the cut-loss-offline lane's 'irretrievable' finding was wrong — it only scanned per-line JSONL content and missed that legacy connectors/anthropic/claude-code-local.js listTranscripts derives kind/parentSessionId from the TRANSCRIPT FILE PATH, not from any field inside the JSONL. sessionId = file basename minus '.jsonl'; parentSessionId = the enclosing <parentSessionId>/subagents/ directory name (null for a top-level file); kind = 'subagent' when parentSessionId is set, else 'session'. This holds even though every line inside a subagent transcript repeats the PARENT's sessionId (confirmed against real ~/.claude/projects data) — the path is a stable identity independent of in-file content. connectors/anthropic/__tests__/claude-code-trajectories.test.cjs pins this exact derivation (agent-abc -> kind 'subagent', parent 'ses-main'). Implemented: packages/polyfill-connectors/connectors/claude_code/index.ts now derives a subagent's own session id from its file basename instead of discarding it into forcedSessionId, adds sessions.kind/sessions.parent_session_id, and adds messages.subagent_session_id so each message is attributable to its own subagent session even though messages.session_id still folds to the parent (matching the legacy fold semantics). See the field-by-field derivation table in reports/cut-claude-lineage.md.
